text:
$QNT’s range blew up – 82.26% in the last 24 h versus a 26.88% weekly avg, ratio over 3. That jump’s hard to ignore.  

$SOL only nudged 5.95% range, a touch above its 4.78% norm, but the price still slid 4.76% overall, so the volatility’s modest.  

15.47% swing for $WLD beats its 13.24% typical spread, ratio 1.17, while it fell 4.83% on the day.  

Something’s stirring in the QNT‑WLD corner; SOL’s move feels more like a side‑note.  

Just a heads‑up, no calls.

$BTC held near $84,550, edging up 0.64% in 24 h. It bounced off the low of $83,838, touched $84,654 and settled just a hair above the day’s open.  

$ETH nudged higher, finishing at $2,707 with a 0.60% gain. The pair swung between $2,664.79 and $2,712.13, staying tight around the $2.70K mark.  

$BNB crept up 0.26% to $775.46. The range was narrow – $766.82 low, $776.19 high – and volume stayed solid around 61 k.  

All three are grinding sideways after modest gains; watch the $84.5‑$85K ceiling for $BTC and the $2.70‑$2.72K band for $ETH as the next resistance zones.
